description: Flat, no subcategories. Classification spec §9. A sector is tagged only when a graded source claim names it, never inferred from actor history or plausibility.
added_in_version_note: Classification spec §24 does not give sector's v1 membership or what changed at v2, and none of this project's own history records it either. Omitted rather than guessed; see telemetry_class-3.json for the shape this field takes where the diff is actually known.
